title: The fresh-admission abort retry of a failed prepared-Begin write previews only its next time, not its attempt and admission-budget deadline
outcome: A head settled for a fresh admission after a failed prepared-Begin write (EngramAbortReason::BeginPreparation) shows a preview naming its attempt and the saved 240 s admission-budget deadline, as the admission-retry preview does. The previews of other abort reasons are unchanged.
acceptance: The fresh-admission abort retry of a failed prepared-Begin write previews only its next time, not its attempt and admission-budget deadline is done
